'''Romar starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on [[Romar]]. On the edge of this [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] there was a warehouse where the [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[T'ar Ta'avon]] lived.
